name: TOXICity
source: It rolled in slowly. In a town in its off-season, no one noticed when the city streets grew empty. No one thought twice about it when people called in sick. And then, while at work, John and his coworker, Kallie, witness an unusual fog surrounding their office. Cellphone service stopped. Phone lines went dead. Almost immediately, they lost contact with the outside world. When they went out to investigate, the fog burned their exposed skin and made them sick. Stranded, they have to find out what’s happening and how they might be rescued. (From Developer)
translation: 它悄悄地、慢慢地涌了进来。小镇正值淡季，街上的人渐渐少了，没人留意。有人打电话请病假，也没人多想。直到约翰和同事凯莉在上班时，亲眼看见一团异样的雾包围了办公室。手机没了信号，电话线也断了。几乎就在转眼之间，他们失去了和外界的一切联系。他们出去一探究竟，露在外面的皮肤却被雾灼伤，人也病倒了。如今两人身陷此地，得弄清究竟发生了什么，又该怎样获救。（取自开发者介绍）
